criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.requirement: Visual presentation of text must maintain a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for large text layouts.

criteria.name: Keyboard Accessible Navigation
criteria.requirement: All functionality of the interface content must be operable through a standard keyboard interaction interface without trapping focus.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value Attributes
criteria.requirement: For all user interface components, the name and role parameters must be explicitly exposed to accessibility assistive agents.
